item.name: POST Upload a private patient document

request.description:
Admin or Dentist required; Dentist plus Receptionist denied unless Admin. Wildcard permissions cannot grant clinical writes. Multipart upload only. PDF, JPEG, PNG, WebP; maximum 20 MiB by default, configurable server-side. Detects MIME from bytes and requires a matching extension, a nonempty file and a valid filename up to 255 characters. Optional links must belong to this patient/clinic and agree when the note has an appointment. Archived patients are allowed. Server owns patient, storage, attribution, size, MIME and timestamps. Metadata and uploaded audit commit atomically; failed metadata/audit writes clean up the object. No URL is returned.

POST /api/patients/{patient}/documents

GET Download a private patient document

request.description:
Same read authorization as metadata, checked on every request. Authenticated API streams the private S3 object as an attachment with original filename, detected Content-Type, nosniff, and private/no-store. No redirects, signed bearer links, public or static URLs. Audits downloaded after the stream opens and before response bytes; this records access, not proof of completed client receipt. Errors use the JSON envelope.

item.name: POST Append a complete dental chart snapshot

request.description:
Admin or Dentist clinical role required; Receptionist plus Dentist is denied unless Admin is also present. Permission wildcards do not bypass clinical writes. expected_version is mandatory (0 for the first revision); stale writes return 409 without changing history or audits. This is a full snapshot, including deliberate omissions/empty lists, not a patch. The server assigns ownership, version, actor and UTC timestamp. Clinical-note links must match patient and provider; treatment links must be clinic-local. Exactly one metadata-only dental_charts/revision_created audit is committed atomically. Existing revisions cannot be updated/deleted. Archived patients are read-only. See docs/dental-charting.md.

Requires appointments.create permission or the admin role. Creates a scheduled appointment. Accepts canonical snake_case fields and documented camelCase aliases; canonical values take precedence. Archived patients and inactive treatments cannot be selected. Duration defaults to the selected treatment duration or 30 minutes. Optional chair_id derives room_id when room_id is omitted. Provider, chair, and room overlaps with active appointments return 422, including across midnight; adjacent intervals are allowed. Offset timestamps are normalized to UTC.
